To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated a novel approach to learning language grounded in the 2D or 3D world via reinforcement learning from the character strings and raw pixel images.

1) the reinforcement learning in the virtual 2D world can be used to bootstrap data efficient reinforcement learning in real world 3D environments; 2) Episodic Control is the key to efficient reinforcement learning.
(a) the reinforcement learning in the virtual 2D world is not data efficient and cannot be used for the learning of language in a 3D world.

the following questions: 1) How to teach dBaby to learn a new language grounded in the 2D or 3D world using the natural language phrases as the only source of information about the world and about the goals of the Teacher?
the following questions: How to design a language grounded Game in 3D world that can be used for reinforcement learning by the Teacher?
creating an artificial agent that can learn to perceive and act in the 3 dimensional world, communicate with humans in a natural language and solve tasks set by the humans.

we propose a project to create an autonomous digital Baby (dBay) that learns language and other skills from a human Teacher in the real world, and we propose a novel EpisodicControl based pre training approach for bootstrapped reinforcement learning.

we are proposing a novel framework for the development of the artificial intelligence that can be used for the creation of the autonomous agents in the real world that can be trained by humans to perform complex tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the language learning Game is not only a way to teach the language to the agent but also a way to train the agent to learn a language.
the reinforcement learning is not only an efficient method for learning the language, but also for learning to interact with the 3d world.
the language learning can be achieved by the agent in the real world through a Game and without hard coding the language and visual capabilities in the agent.
